openQuestions.title: Humanize the recognition error states
openQuestions.detail: Map not-allowed/no-speech/network error codes to actionable text ('microphone permission denied — click the address-bar mic icon to allow') instead of the bare 'error: not-allowed'; this is the branch every permission-denied visitor hits.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked 🎙 Dictate; real SpeechRecognition started and honestly surfaced 'error: not-allowed' from the sandbox's denied mic, zero console errors — the error text is honest but unexplained.
